Previously, I developed models for music source separation and music–lyrics synchronization at GAUDIOLAB. At VIVESTUDIOS, I worked on VSpeech, an integrated TTS and voice conversion model for virtual humans. At SM Entertainment, I developed a singing assessment module for EVERYSING and worked on personalized celebrity TTS.
My experience also includes Android applications and audio DSP. I have shared my research and development experience through corporate training, courses and public talks.
I studied Music Composition with a double major in Computer Science at Seoul National University.

en: I am currently an independent researcher working on diffusion sampling and generative models for images and audio. In Dual-Solver, published at ICLR 2026, I studied a generalized ODE solver through parameterization of prediction types. In RBF-Solver, I explored multistep sampling with radial basis function interpolation. I also lead logp(x) at MODULABS, where we study the core principles of generative models.

Previously, I developed models for source separation, music–lyrics synchronization, speech synthesis and voice conversion at companies including GAUDIOLAB and VIVESTUDIOS. My work on GSEP, HCLAS-X and KimchiSpeech connects with this background in audio and speech.
I have taught courses on Stable Diffusion, generative models and Bayesian statistics, and shared research through generative modeling study groups and public talks.
I studied Music Composition with a double major in Computer Science at Seoul National University.

reason.en: Connects your current generative modeling research with music and speech product development and creative projects. Useful for understanding your experience relevant to games and content.

ko: 현재 이미지·오디오 생성 모델을 연구하며, Dual-Solver(ICLR 2026)와 RBF-Solver를 통해 디퓨전 샘플링의 속도와 품질을 다루고 있습니다. 모두의연구소에서는 생성 모델 연구 랩 logp(x)를 운영하고 있습니다.
가우디오랩에서는 GTS 음악·가사 동기화 모델을, 비브스튜디오스에서는 버츄얼 휴먼을 위한 TTS·voice conversion 통합 모델인 VSpeech를 연구했습니다. 그 이전에는 가우디오랩의 GSEP 음원 분리·FOLLE 사운드 생성 모델과 SM Entertainment의 에브리싱 가창 평가·셀러브리티 개인화 TTS를 개발했습니다.
음악 게임의 오디오 출력 모듈과 음악 스트리밍·노래방 앱을 개발한 경험도 있습니다. 인터랙티브 음악 WOBBLE과 청음 훈련 앱 Earoid를 제작했으며, 강의를 통해 연구와 개발 경험을 공유해 왔습니다.
서울대학교에서 작곡을 전공하고 컴퓨터공학을 복수전공했습니다.
en: I currently research image and audio generation, including diffusion sampling speed and quality through Dual-Solver, published at ICLR 2026, and RBF-Solver. I also lead the logp(x) generative models research lab at MODULABS.

At GAUDIOLAB, I worked on GTS for music–lyrics synchronization. At VIVESTUDIOS, I worked on VSpeech, an integrated TTS and voice conversion model for virtual humans. Earlier, my work included GSEP for source separation and FOLLE for sound generation at GAUDIOLAB, and singing assessment for EVERYSING and personalized celebrity TTS at SM Entertainment.

My experience also includes audio output for music games, music streaming and karaoke applications, the interactive music work WOBBLE, and the ear-training application Earoid. I have shared my research and development experience through teaching.
I studied Music Composition with a double major in Computer Science at Seoul National University.

en: I am currently an independent researcher working on image and audio generation and diffusion sampling, including Dual-Solver, published at ICLR 2026, and RBF-Solver. I also lead the logp(x) generative models lab at MODULABS.
Previously, I developed music and speech AI models at GAUDIOLAB, VIVESTUDIOS and SM Entertainment.
I have shared my research and development experience through corporate and institutional courses and public talks.
I studied Music Composition with a double major in Computer Science at Seoul National University.

original.ko: 인공지능 기술을 활용한 이미지 및 오디오 생성 연구를 하고 있습니다. 여러 스타트업에서 음악 게임, 어플리케이션, 음성 및 사운드와 관련 딥러닝 모델을 개발해 왔습니다. 모두의연구소에서 생성 모델들의 핵심 원리를 연구하는 랩을 운영하고 있고, 이러한 기술들을 널리 알리기 위한 강의 활동도 이어나가고 있습니다.
original.en: I conduct research on generative models for images and audio. I have developed deep learning models related to music games and applications, as well as speech and sound, across multiple startups. I currently work as an independent researcher based on this experience. I also lead a lab at MODULABS that studies core principles of generative models, and I continue to teach courses to help disseminate these techniques.
